The #1 Open-Source CRM

Website · Documentation · Roadmap · Discord · Figma


# Why Twenty Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves. Twenty is the CRM you build, ship, and version like the rest of your stack. Learn more about why we built Twenty
# Installation ### Cloud The fastest way to get started. Sign up at [twenty.com](https://twenty.com) and spin up a workspace in under a minute, with no infrastructure to manage and always up to date. ### Build an app Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI: ```bash npm install -g twenty twenty app init my-app cd my-app yarn install ``` Define objects, fields, and views as code: ```ts import { defineObject, FieldType } from 'twenty-sdk/define'; export default defineObject({ nameSingular: 'deal', namePlural: 'deals', labelSingular: 'Deal', labelPlural: 'Deals', fields: [ { name: 'name', label: 'Name', type: FieldType.TEXT }, { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: FieldType.CURRENCY }, { name: 'closeDate', label: 'Close Date', type: FieldType.DATE_TIME }, ], }); ``` Then ship it to your workspace: ```bash twenty auth login --url https://your-workspace.twenty.com twenty app publish --private ``` See the [app development guide](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/apps/getting-started) for objects, views, agents, and logic functions. Building with a coding agent? Install the official [Twenty app skills](./packages/twenty-agent-skills), which work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and any other harness supported by the `skills` CLI: ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/tree/agent-skills --list ``` The `agent-skills` branch is created by the first successful publish from `main`. Until then, use the [local build instructions](./packages/twenty-agent-skills#local-development). [`SKILLS.md`](./SKILLS.md) explains the other skill families in this repository and who they are for. ### Self-hosting Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with [Docker Compose](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/self-host/capabilities/docker-compose), or contribute locally via the [local setup guide](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/contribute/capabilities/local-setup).

# Everything you need Twenty gives you the building blocks of a modern CRM (objects, views, workflows, and agents) and lets you extend them as code. Here's a tour of what's in the box. Want to go deeper? Read the User Guide for product walkthroughs, or the Documentation for developer reference.

The #1 Open-Source CRM

Website · Documentation · Roadmap · Discord · Figma


Why Twenty

Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves. Twenty is the CRM you build, ship, and version like the rest of your stack.

Learn more about why we built Twenty


Installation

Cloud

The fastest way to get started. Sign up at twenty.com and spin up a workspace in under a minute, with no infrastructure to manage and always up to date.

Build an app

Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI:

npm install -g twenty
twenty app init my-app
cd my-app
yarn install

Define objects, fields, and views as code:

import { defineObject, FieldType } from 'twenty-sdk/define';

export default defineObject({
  nameSingular: 'deal',
  namePlural: 'deals',
  labelSingular: 'Deal',
  labelPlural: 'Deals',
  fields: [
    { name: 'name', label: 'Name', type: FieldType.TEXT },
    { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: FieldType.CURRENCY },
    { name: 'closeDate', label: 'Close Date', type: FieldType.DATE_TIME },
  ],
});

Then ship it to your workspace:

twenty auth login --url https://your-workspace.twenty.com
twenty app publish --private

See the app development guide for objects, views, agents, and logic functions.

Building with a coding agent? Install the official Twenty app skills, which work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and any other harness supported by the skills CLI:

npx skills add https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/tree/agent-skills --list

The agent-skills branch is created by the first successful publish from main. Until then, use the local build instructions. SKILLS.md explains the other skill families in this repository and who they are for.

Self-hosting

Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, or contribute locally via the local setup guide.



Everything you need

Twenty gives you the building blocks of a modern CRM (objects, views, workflows, and agents) and lets you extend them as code. Here's a tour of what's in the box.

Want to go deeper? Read the User Guide for product walkthroughs, or the Documentation for developer reference.

releases.body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

This patch fixes an upgrade failure that hit some v2.56 workspaces. Workflow code steps containing NUL characters caused the upgrade command to stall and not complete.

Those steps are now skipped, and the upgrade finishes normally. If your workspace was stuck after upgrading to v2.56, this release unblocks it.

## 🌟 Highlights

- Workflow code steps containing NUL characters no longer block the v2.56 upgrade command. ([#29805](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29805))

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- Workflow code steps containing NUL characters no longer block the v2.56 upgrade command. Affected steps are skipped so the upgrade can complete. ([#29805](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29805)) by @charlesBochet

<details>
<summary>Full changelog (1 PRs)</summary>

- Skip code step sources containing NUL in the inline command (v2.56) ([#29805](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29805)) by @charlesBochet

</details>

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/compare/twenty/v2.56.0...twenty/v2.56.1

releases.name: twenty/v2.55.0
releases.body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

AI chat can now build, preview, and publish frontend components in your workspace. Describe what you need, and the agent writes and renders it with sample data before asking for your approval. Five breaking changes ship with this release; API consumers and self-hosters should check that section before upgrading.

Records can now be made private. A private record is visible only to its creator and the people it is shared with directly. Roles do not reach it, including admin.

The LinkedIn app gained a Sync tab. It can import your conversation history and create or match People from contacts. Image, video, and audio attachments come along.

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- Every webhook now requires a role. Pass a `roleId` when calling `createWebhook`, and provide the `ROLES` permission alongside `API_KEYS_AND_WEBHOOKS` to create or edit webhooks. ([#29273](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29273)) by @charlesBochet
- App settings tabs now support a URL slug. `Connect` and `Reconnect` now land on the app's first settings tab; any bookmarked routes to tab fragments may need updating. ([#29355](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29355)) by @mart

aiSummary.oneLiner: A modern, open-source CRM platform allowing extensive customization and extension through code and AI agents.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Twenty provides the foundational building blocks of a modern Customer Relationship Management system, including objects, views, workflows, and agents. It distinguishes itself by allowing developers to extend and customize the platform heavily through code, treating the CRM as a programmable infrastructure rather than a rigid SaaS application. The platform features an integrated app development ecosystem where users can define custom objects and logic functions using TypeScript, which can then be published and version-controlled. Furthermore, it incorporates AI agents and chat interfaces directly into the CRM experience, streamlining data entry and customer interactions. It is built on a robust enterprise-ready stack including NestJS, PostgreSQL, React, and Redis.
keyFeatures: Programmable Infrastructure: Allows developers to extend CRM functionalities using custom code and defined logic functions.
Custom Objects: Enables the creation of bespoke data models and fields using a TypeScript-based schema definition.
Version Control Integration: Supports publishing and managing custom CRM applications with integrated version control.
AI Agent Workflows: Incorporates AI agents and chat interfaces to automate tasks and enhance user interaction.
Self-Hosted Deployment: Offers full self-hosting capabilities via Docker Compose for complete data sovereignty.
Modern Technology Stack: Built on a high-performance stack featuring NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and React.

useCases.description: Sales teams utilize integrated AI agents to automatically summarize interactions and update deal stages.

useCases.title: Data Sovereignty Compliance
useCases.description: Enterprises deploy the platform on their own infrastructure using Docker to maintain strict control over customer data.

useCases.title: Developer-Centric Customization
useCases.description: Build and version-control CRM extensions using familiar TypeScript and Node.js tooling.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Twenty is designed for engineering and revenue operations teams who find traditional CRMs too restrictive and desire a programmable, open-source alternative. It requires technical familiarity with TypeScript, React, and database management.
